Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 382/2024 dated 4.10.2024 registered at Police Station Mandi, District Sehore for the offence punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code.
sentences._hearing_file: Rajkumar Raghuwanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: 2. The counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
sentences._hearing_file: Rajkumar Raghuwanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 January, 2025.json

sentences.text:
As per prosecutrix's own statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.,
the applicant and the prosecutrix came in touch in November, 2021.
sentences._hearing_file: Rajkumar Raghuwanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: They were in friendship and later on they had physical relations as well.
sentences._hearing_file: Rajkumar Raghuwanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: The prosecutrix is a major lady aged about 29 years and the applicant is aged about 34 years.
sentences._hearing_file: Rajkumar Raghuwanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: He has no criminal past.
sentences._hearing_file: Rajkumar Raghuwanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: The applicant is ready to co-operate with the investigation and NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:995 2 MCRC-56365-2024 trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Rajkumar Raghuwanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: Trial would take considerable time to conclude, therefore, the applicant be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Rajkumar Raghuwanshi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 January, 2025.json

sentences.text: 5. Looking to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. and the age of the prosecutrix as well as the applicant, this Court finds it to be a fit case to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.
